purpose: Convert the measured JXL baseline into the exact entropy-stream rate each registered model arm must reach, and record the static-model floor that any competent DCT entropy coder should already beat.

static_floor_derivation.method: empirical entropy of each (component, frequency-position) group, 3 components x 64 positions = 192 static histograms, measured on frozen photo A
static_floor_derivation.coefficient_layout: component-planar, offset 140, int16; Y 157344 blocks, Cb 39336 blocks, Cr 39336 blocks, 64 coefficients per block
static_floor_derivation.note: This costs a few KB of tables and no network. It already beats the original JPEG by 9.0 percent and sits 10.9 percent above JXL.

arms.verdict_reason: The best published learned JPEG recompression result is about 31 percent better than JPEG on its own dataset. This arm needs 45.6 percent at N=96.
25.4 percent required against a published best of about 31 percent. Viable if the model actually trains.

model_budget_ceiling.assumption: candidate reaches the best published result, 31 percent better than original JPEG, i.e. 1.1159 bits per coefficient
model_budget_ceiling.official_width_break_even_note: 204 photos is inside the approved 93-300 range but this project has 96, so the arm remains a formal loss here.

training_state_assessment.reported_metric_units: bits per luma pixel; patch has 98304 coefficients per 65536 luma positions, so divide by 1.5 for bits per coefficient
training_state_assessment.interpretation: A model that had learned nothing but the pooled variance would sit at 8.02. Being at 11.82 means predicted scales are systematically about 14x too wide, which is not an early-training level but a conditioning fault.
training_state_assessment.suspected_cause: config coefficient_value_transform = exact_float32_cast_without_normalization, fed to a shared scale head that must span a 2924x per-frequency dynamic range (Y DC std 490.4 to highest-frequency std 0.168)
training_state_assessment.aux_optimizer_hypothesis: refuted; build_optimizers isolates .quantiles into a separate Adam at lr 1e-3 and train_batch steps it every batch
